result.description:
Need quick help with general advising questions? The CNAS Undergraduate Academic Advising Center is offering general drop-in advising virtually. The advisor-on-call may not be an advisor for your major. These advising check-in sessions are meant for quick, general questions and will last only 5 minutes.

TIPS FOR A SMOOTH AND SUCCESSFUL CNAS GUAC VISIT:
Respond promptly when notified. You will receive an email and/or text when the advisor-on-call is ready to meet with you.
Plan ahead & stay nearby. Make sure you have time set aside. Be ready and near the advising center for in-person advising, or log in to Zoom for virtual advising.
Don't lose your spot. If you miss your notification, you'll be returned to the queue and will need to wait again to receive another notification.
